_description: This closed roster declares the New Zealand v0 export inputs. Donor records remain US support records. The graph must select exact entity-qualified export and gate slices from the required and optional columns. Encoded inputs enter only when axiom_input_closure.json and this roster both name them. The export kernel writes every column that its selected frame carries; this roster alone does not project or enforce those slices. formula_owned_excluded names every output that the graph requests from the bound rulespec-nz modules, and the graph must exclude those outputs from its export slices.

_weight_contract.family_weight_resolution: The frame must call resolve_weights('family'); each family must map to exactly one household and inherit that household's calibrated weight.

_assigned_receipt_inputs.receives_jobseeker_support: The receipt kernel assigns this person-level snapshot flag; the donor does not observe NZ receipt.
_assigned_receipt_inputs.receives_sole_parent_support: The receipt kernel assigns this person-level snapshot flag; the donor does not observe NZ receipt.
_assigned_receipt_inputs.receives_supported_living_payment: The receipt kernel assigns this person-level snapshot flag; the donor does not observe NZ receipt.
_assigned_receipt_inputs.receives_nz_super: The receipt kernel assigns this person-level snapshot flag; the donor does not observe NZ receipt.

_slice_requirement: G8-w3b must declare the exact entity-qualified export and terminal-gate slices. H12 still requires closed-roster enforcement for all replay-required normalized or encoded inputs. export.prepare@1 currently accepts entities, weight_entity, time_period and optional bindings, then emits a descriptor that materialize_export writes; it does not read this roster. The hub must resolve any required shared-code enforcement separately.
